actions.evidence: June shortfall of 3,047.70 USD over 30 active days. Full-window z = -4.570.
actions.assumptions: Use June's observed gap as a daily proxy. Assume a 0% / 50% / 80% chance of verifying a correctable issue and restoring the full gap in-package. Deduct two hours of expected theo in each case. This prices the inspection package.

If an authorized correction is made, track daily hold minus configured hold, bet-weighted payout z and availability for 29 days against comparable G-STD90 machines. Record the inspection outcome.

actions.evidence: Back Forty took 135.48 USD per available hour pre-closure and 120.17 in June. June availability and game mix set the scale.
actions.assumptions: Recover 10% / 40% / 65% of the hourly gap. Retain 50% / 65% / 80% after displacement. Convert handle to theo at June game mix and deduct the 20% lease share on the revenue-share mix as a contribution proxy.
actions.measurement: Install at the Main Entrance approach. Compare Back Forty with the other zones on matching weekdays before and after activation. Track entries per valid sensor hour, wagers per available machine-hour and floor-wide theo after lease share. Flag displaced play and competing events.
